pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. A yearly planner containing EXACTLY TWELVE small MONTH PANELS arranged in THREE ROWS of FOUR columns, all panels same size, orderly left-to-right then top-to-bottom from January through December. Every month panel looks like a tiny calendar: a blank top binding strip and a small grid of empty day boxes with NO text or digits. ONLY the SECOND month panel, located ROW ONE COLUMN TWO, is pale red with a thick red outer border. All other ELEVEN panels white with gray borders. One small red downward arrow points precisely to the selected month panel, without hiding any other panel. This selected ordinal month represents a specific month of the year. Make all twelve clearly countable, all panels fully inside frame. NO month names, dates, letters, numerals, labels or writing.  Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
